examples.purpose: A hypothetical incident review that keeps a quoted report, its reconstruction, and a later reuse of the same evidence apart; an objection to that evidence differs from objections to the new step and to the report's own step.
A hypothetical lab anomaly where two observations support the explanation only jointly, beside an independent reason, a competing explanation, and open checks.
A compact philosophical reconstruction with textual and translation notes.
The smallest public onboarding inquiry used by the site and Playground.
A hypothetical reading inquiry with a stated reason; Logseq-shaped properties remain body without claiming native adapter support.

A paraphrased reconstruction of Plato's cyclical argument (Phaedo 70c–72d) with a joint and an independent route, one reused conclusion, our objections to premise content versus a step, and a separately labelled test of a stronger conclusion.
A legal-policy inquiry with a provisional conclusion, privacy objection, reply, and missing governing rule.
A minimal local joint-support reconstruction that keeps both premises as Grounds.
